metadata.description: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Technique Catalog — observability detection mapping

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to get into your network.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.

sub_techniques.name: Spearphishing Attachment
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with a malicious attachment.

sub_techniques.name: Spearphishing Link
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with a malicious link.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing host.

tactics.name: Execution
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to run malicious code.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.

sub_techniques.name: PowerShell
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.

sub_techniques.name: Windows Command Shell
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse task scheduling functionality to facilitate execution.

sub_techniques.name: Scheduled Task
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse Windows Task Scheduler to perform task scheduling.

tactics.name: Persistence
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to maintain their foothold.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation
techniques.description: Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain access.

sub_techniques.name: Additional Cloud Credentials
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may add adversary-controlled credentials to a cloud account.

techniques.name: Create Account
techniques.description: Adversaries may create an account to maintain access.

sub_techniques.name: Local Account
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may create a local account to maintain access.

sub_techniques.name: Cloud Account
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may create a cloud account to maintain access.

tactics.name: Privilege Escalation
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to gain higher-level permissions.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts.

sub_techniques.name: Default Accounts
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of a default account.

sub_techniques.name: Cloud Accounts
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of a cloud account.

tactics.name: Defense Evasion
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to avoid being detected.

techniques.name: Indicator Removal
techniques.description: Adversaries may delete or modify artifacts generated within systems.

sub_techniques.name: Clear Windows Event Logs
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may clear Windows Event Logs to hide activity.

sub_techniques.name: Clear Command History
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may clear the command history of a compromised account.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.description: Adversaries may maliciously modify components of a victim environment.

sub_techniques.name: Disable or Modify Tools
sub_techniques.description: Adversaries may modify or disable security tools to avoid detection.
